description: Reusable skill challenge templates for contextual gameplay with balance tuning
note: Updated for new 13-skill system with comprehensive balance framework. Skills: athletics, acrobatics, sleightOfHand, endurance, academia, arcana, investigation, perception, cunning, creativity, empathy, influence, deception.

trap_detect_disarm.name: Trap Detection & Disarm
trap_detect_disarm.description: You notice suspicious markings on the floor ahead...

stages.description: Notice the trap before triggering it

onSuccess.message: You spot the trap mechanism!

onFailure.message: You trigger the trap!

stages.description: Carefully disable the trap mechanism

onSuccess.message: You successfully disarm the trap!

onFailure.message: Your hand slips...

criticalSuccess.message: Masterful work! You find a hidden compartment with treasure

criticalFailure.message: The trap was more deadly than you thought...

locked_door.name: Locked Door
locked_door.description: A locked door bars your way. Choose how to get through - but choose wisely, failure means this door stays shut forever.

options.description: Pick the lock with finesse

onSuccess.message: You pick the lock and the door swings open silently.

onFailure.message: You break your lockpick. The lock remains intact.

options.description: Force the door open with brute strength

onSuccess.message: You smash the door open with brute force!

onFailure.message: You hurt your shoulder trying to break down the door.

options.description: Detect and dispel magical lock

onSuccess.message: You identify a magical seal and dispel it!

onFailure.message: The magical seal resists your attempts.

bandit_negotiation.name: Bandit Negotiation
bandit_negotiation.description: Bandits block your path. Perhaps you can avoid bloodshed?

options.description: Threaten or persuade the bandits to leave

onSuccess.message: The bandits are convinced by your words and flee!

onFailure.message: The bandits reject your words and attack!

options.description: Trick the bandits with false information

onSuccess.message: The bandits believe your lie about approaching guards and flee!

onFailure.message: The bandits see through your deception and attack!

options.description: Appeal to their better nature

onSuccess.message: You connect with the bandits emotionally. They agree to leave peacefully!

onFailure.message: Your emotional appeal falls flat and they attack!

cliff_climb.name: Cliff Climbing
cliff_climb.description: A towering cliff face blocks your path

stages.description: Spot the best climbing route

onSuccess.message: You identify handholds and a safe path.

onFailure.message: You begin climbing without a clear plan.

stages.description: Climb the cliff face

onSuccess.message: You pull yourself over the lip. The valley falls away below you.

onFailure.message: Your boot finds nothing. Three seconds of silence, then stone.

hidden_treasure.name: Hidden Treasure Search
hidden_treasure.description: This chamber looks like it might hide secrets...

stages.description: Search the area methodically

onSuccess.message: You find signs of a hidden compartment!

onFailure.message: You find nothing of interest.

stages.description: Open the hidden compartment

onSuccess.message: Your fingers find the latch. Inside: worth the trouble.

onFailure.message: The mechanism is seized. Whatever's inside stays inside.

calm_wild_beast.name: Calm Wild Beast
calm_wild_beast.description: A wild animal blocks your path, snarling aggressively

onSuccess.message: The animal reads you. Something in your stillness tells it you're not prey. It moves off.

onFailure.message: The animal remains hostile and attacks!

options.description: Move silently past the guards

onSuccess.message: You slip past the guards unnoticed.

onFailure.message: Your heel finds a loose stone. A guard turns.

options.description: Hide in the shadows and wait for an opening

onSuccess.message: You blend into the shadows and slip past when they're not looking.

onFailure.message: A guard spots you hiding!

options.description: Bluff your way past with confidence

onSuccess.message: You walk past confidently and the guards don't question you.

onFailure.message: The guards challenge you and attack!

arcane_puzzle.name: Arcane Puzzle
arcane_puzzle.description: Ancient runes glow faintly on the door ahead

options.description: Use magical knowledge to solve the puzzle

onSuccess.message: You understand the magical principles and solve the puzzle!

onFailure.message: The puzzle remains unsolved.

options.description: Examine the puzzle for patterns

onSuccess.message: Through careful observation, you solve the puzzle!

onFailure.message: The puzzle is too complex to understand.

options.description: Think outside the box for an unconventional solution

onSuccess.message: Your creative approach reveals a hidden solution!

onFailure.message: Your unconventional approach doesn't work.

ancient_text.name: Decipher Ancient Text
ancient_text.description: Ancient writing covers the stone tablet

onSuccess.message: You translate the ancient text and gain valuable information!

onFailure.message: The text is too damaged or complex to understand.

stabilize_wounded.name: Stabilize Wounded NPC
stabilize_wounded.description: A wounded person lies before you, bleeding heavily

options.description: Apply scholarly medical knowledge

onSuccess.message: You stabilize the wounded person using your medical knowledge!

onFailure.message: Despite your efforts, the person's condition worsens.

options.description: Examine the wounds and apply practical first aid

onSuccess.message: You identify the injury and treat it effectively!

onFailure.message: You cannot determine how to help them.

track_creature.name: Track Creature
track_creature.description: You notice animal tracks and signs of passage through the area

stages.description: Examine the tracks more closely

onSuccess.message: You identify fresh tracks leading away from here. The creature passed through recently.

onFailure.message: The tracks are too faint or confused to follow.

stages.description: Follow the trail to discover where it leads

onSuccess.message: The signs are everywhere once you know them: a pressed reed, a turned stone, a blood-fleck on bark. You have it.

onFailure.message: You lose the trail in the undergrowth.

detect_lie.name: Detect Deception
detect_lie.description: Something about their story doesn't add up...

onSuccess.message: You sense the NPC is being deceptive!

onFailure.message: You believe the NPC is telling the truth.

creative_distraction.name: Create Distraction
creative_distraction.description: You need to divert attention away from your true goal

onSuccess.message: Your clever distraction works perfectly, creating an opening!

onFailure.message: Your distraction attempt fails to fool anyone.

holy_ritual.name: Perform Holy Ritual
holy_ritual.description: The sacred site calls for blessing

onSuccess.message: You successfully perform the ritual. The area is blessed!

onFailure.message: The ritual fails to take effect.

narrow_ledge.name: Narrow Ledge
narrow_ledge.description: A narrow ledge is the only way forward

stages.description: Read the ledge before you commit

onSuccess.message: The ledge is narrow — six inches, maybe eight. You note where to step.

onFailure.message: You approach without a plan.

stages.description: Cross the narrow ledge

onSuccess.message: You make it across. Don't look down was good advice.

onFailure.message: The ledge crumbles under your foot. Stone and then air.

endure_harsh_environment.name: Endure Harsh Environment
endure_harsh_environment.description: The extreme conditions test your limits

stages.description: Read the terrain for what's coming

onSuccess.message: The ground tells a story: scorched rock, dead insects, cracked mud. You know what this means.

onFailure.message: The conditions build without warning.

stages.description: Endure the harsh conditions

onSuccess.message: You push through the harsh conditions!

onFailure.message: The conditions overwhelm you.

boulder_push.name: Move Heavy Boulder
boulder_push.description: A massive boulder blocks your path

onSuccess.message: The boulder grinds aside. Behind it: packed earth, and beneath that, something worth hiding.

onFailure.message: You strain your muscles but the boulder won't budge.

mountain_climb.name: Mountain Climbing
mountain_climb.description: Steep mountain slopes require careful navigation

stages.description: Find the safest climbing route

onSuccess.message: You identify a manageable path up the mountain!

onFailure.message: You proceed without a clear route.

stages.description: Scale the steep slope

onSuccess.message: You successfully climb the mountain!

onFailure.message: You slip and fall!

heat_endurance.name: Desert Heat Wave
heat_endurance.description: The scorching sun beats down relentlessly

stages.description: Notice the heat before it becomes something else

onSuccess.message: The air above the sand shimmers. You slow down, drink, cover exposed skin. Not yet, but coming.

onFailure.message: The heat builds without warning.

stages.description: Endure the scorching heat

onSuccess.message: You endure the extreme heat and press onward!

onFailure.message: The heat overwhelms you.

swamp_navigation.name: Navigate Treacherous Swamp
swamp_navigation.description: The murky swamp conceals dangerous ground

options.description: Probe ahead carefully with a stick

onSuccess.message: You identify safe paths through the swamp!

onFailure.message: You step into quicksand!

options.description: Hop between solid ground patches

onSuccess.message: You nimbly navigate the swamp!

onFailure.message: You lose your footing and sink!

options.description: Use knowledge of wetlands to identify safe paths

onSuccess.message: Your knowledge guides you safely through!

onFailure.message: The swamp is more treacherous than expected.

dense_undergrowth.name: Dense Jungle Undergrowth
dense_undergrowth.description: Thick vines and vegetation block your path

onSuccess.message: You find a path through the dense vegetation!

onFailure.message: Thorny vines tear at your skin.

cliff_climb_advanced.name: Scale Mountain Peak
cliff_climb_advanced.description: The near-vertical peak demands expert climbing

stages.description: Study the treacherous peak route

onSuccess.message: You map out a challenging but possible route!

onFailure.message: The route looks insurmountable.

stages.description: Ascend the perilous peak

onSuccess.message: You reach the summit!

onFailure.message: You lose your grip and plummet!

ice_climbing.name: Ice Wall Climbing
ice_climbing.description: A wall of slick ice blocks your path

stages.description: Read the ice before you commit your weight

onSuccess.message: The blue-grey patches hold. The white streaks don't. You file that away.

onFailure.message: You begin climbing without reading the ice.

stages.description: Climb the ice wall

onSuccess.message: Handhold by handhold. You reach the top and press your face against the cold.

onFailure.message: Your grip breaks. The wall rushes past you.

river_crossing.name: Cross Swift River
river_crossing.description: A fast-flowing river blocks your path

options.description: Wade across the current

onSuccess.message: You power through the current and reach the other side!

onFailure.message: The current sweeps you downstream!

options.description: Leap across stepping stones

onSuccess.message: You nimbly hop across the river!

onFailure.message: You slip on a wet stone and fall in!

options.description: Find a shallow crossing point

onSuccess.message: You discover a safe ford and cross easily!

onFailure.message: You misjudge the depth and get swept away!

guard_patrol.name: Guard Patrol
guard_patrol.description: City guards approach, demanding to know your business.

onSuccess.message: The guards nod and wave you through.

onFailure.message: The guards remain suspicious and demand you leave the area.

onSuccess.message: The guards pocket the coin and look the other way.

onFailure.message: The guards are offended and threaten arrest!

choices.text: Blend into the crowd and slip away

onSuccess.message: You disappear into the crowd before they notice.

onFailure.message: The guards spot you and give chase!

market_haggle.name: Market Haggling
market_haggle.description: A merchant offers goods at inflated prices. You could negotiate for a better deal.

onSuccess.message: The merchant grudgingly accepts your counteroffer!

onFailure.message: The merchant refuses to budge on price.

pickpocket_attempt.name: Pickpocket Encounter
pickpocket_attempt.description: You notice a pickpocket attempting to steal from a nearby merchant.

choices.text: Catch the thief and demand they return the goods

onSuccess.message: You catch the thief! The merchant rewards you.

onFailure.message: The thief escapes into the crowd.

onSuccess.message: Guards arrive quickly and apprehend the thief.

onFailure.message: By the time guards arrive, the thief is long gone.

onSuccess.message: You mind your own business.

warehouse_sneak.name: Warehouse Infiltration
warehouse_sneak.description: You notice suspicious activity in a warehouse. Investigate?

stages.description: Hide in the shadows and observe

onSuccess.message: You spot smugglers loading contraband!

onFailure.message: A guard spots movement and investigates!

stages.description: Search for evidence of criminal activity

onSuccess.message: You find smuggling manifests! The city guard will reward this.

onFailure.message: You find nothing conclusive.

crop_trampling.name: Crop Field Crossing
crop_trampling.description: You need to cross farmland. The farmer watches suspiciously.

onSuccess.message: The farmer grants permission and shows you the safest path.

onFailure.message: The farmer refuses and warns you away.

choices.text: Navigate carefully to avoid trampling crops

onSuccess.message: You cross without damaging the crops.

onFailure.message: You accidentally trample several rows! The farmer demands compensation.

choices.text: Walk straight through, crops be damned

onSuccess.message: You cross quickly but anger the farmer.

forge_accident.name: Forge Fire
forge_accident.description: A forge fire has gotten out of control! Help extinguish it?

stages.description: Brave the heat to get close to the fire

onSuccess.message: You withstand the intense heat!

onFailure.message: The heat is too intense!

stages.description: Pour water and beat back the flames

onSuccess.message: You successfully extinguish the blaze! The workers are grateful.

onFailure.message: The fire spreads! Workers rush to help.

predator_stalk.name: Predator Stalking
predator_stalk.description: Something is following you. The grass is too still.

stages.description: Notice the predator before it commits

onSuccess.message: A shadow at the edge of the tall grass. Eyes. You stop moving.

onFailure.message: You sense something wrong. Too late to do anything about it.

stages.description: Face down the predator

onSuccess.message: The predator backs down. You hold your ground until it turns.

onFailure.message: It charges. You had no good options anyway.

desert_wayfinding.name: Desert Wayfinding
desert_wayfinding.description: The dunes all look the same. The sun is moving. You need to orient before you lose another hour.

stages.description: Read the sun and landscape for orientation

onSuccess.message: The sun is a clock. You triangulate against two ridgelines and a dune shadow. Heading set.

onFailure.message: The glare is blinding. You pick a direction and hope.

stages.description: Hold your bearing through the heat

onSuccess.message: The heat tries everything. You're still pointed the right way when the dunes break open.

onFailure.message: The sun shifts. So do your footprints. You've been walking in a slow arc for the last hour.

beach_salvage.name: Shipwreck Salvage
beach_salvage.description: Debris from a shipwreck bobs in the shallows. Something in there is worth the cold.

stages.description: Spot salvageable cargo before the tide takes it

onSuccess.message: A sealed crate. Still floating. You mark its drift and move.

onFailure.message: Splinters and sailcloth. You wade in anyway.

stages.description: Drag the cargo clear of the surf

onSuccess.message: Cold to the bone. Worth it.

onFailure.message: The surf takes it. You watch it go under.

gather_rumors.name: Gather Rumors
gather_rumors.description: The innkeeper has an ear for local gossip. You could try to draw them out.

choices.text: Buy them a drink and ask casually — Empathy DC 11 (costs 5 gold)

onSuccess.message: Over a shared drink, the innkeeper lets slip something useful.

onFailure.message: They smile politely and change the subject.

choices.text: Ask directly — you heard there's trouble — Investigation DC 14

onSuccess.message: Your direct approach catches them off guard. They confirm what you suspected.

onFailure.message: They clam up. Too forward.

choices.text: Spin a cover story about being a traveling merchant — Deception DC 13

onSuccess.message: Your false identity opens doors. The innkeeper warns you about the roads.

onFailure.message: They see through the act. Their expression cools.

appraise_goods.name: Appraise Goods
appraise_goods.description: You want to know if this merchant's wares are worth the asking price.

onSuccess.message: You assess the stock with a practiced eye. You know exactly what's worth buying.

onFailure.message: The quality is hard to judge. You're not sure what's genuine.

identify_item_quality.name: Read the Craft
identify_item_quality.description: A blacksmith's work reveals their skill. You could tell a lot by examining the forge.

onSuccess.message: You spot the hallmarks of exceptional craft. This smith knows their trade.

onFailure.message: The metalwork is competent but you can't read more than that.

craft_assistance.name: Lend a Hand
craft_assistance.description: The blacksmith is in the middle of a difficult job. You could help — or hinder.

choices.text: Grip the metal and work the bellows — Athletics DC 14

onSuccess.message: You haul and hold. The smith nods, impressed. The job goes faster.

onFailure.message: You fumble the grip. The smith waves you off, jaw tight.

choices.text: Suggest a technique from something you've studied — Academia DC 13

onSuccess.message: The smith raises an eyebrow, tries it, and it works. Respect earned.

onFailure.message: The suggestion falls flat. Book learning doesn't translate here.

intimidate_npc.name: Intimidating Presence
intimidate_npc.description: You make clear that obstructing you would be unwise.

onSuccess.message: They measure you and decide cooperation costs less than resistance.

onFailure.message: They hold your gaze. Your threat lands hollow.

negotiate.name: Negotiate Terms
negotiate.description: Propose a mutual benefit — appeal to their self-interest.

onSuccess.message: They see the angle and nod slowly. Terms accepted.

onFailure.message: The deal doesn't look appealing enough to them.

persuade_npc.name: Make Your Case
persuade_npc.description: Find an unexpected angle they hadn't considered — lateral thinking, not direct pressure.

onSuccess.message: Your argument is clear and well-reasoned. They yield the point.

onFailure.message: They're not convinced. Perhaps another approach.

gather_information.name: Ask the Guard
gather_information.description: Guards see everything that moves through a settlement.

choices.text: Ask casually about recent activity — Influence DC 12

onSuccess.message: The guard relaxes and shares what they've seen lately.

onFailure.message: They're not in a talkative mood. 'Move along.'

choices.text: Claim you're investigating on behalf of the town — Deception DC 15

onSuccess.message: The authority of the claim loosens their tongue considerably.

onFailure.message: They know the real investigators. This doesn't add up.

choices.text: Don't ask — read their posture and fill in the gaps — Empathy DC 14

onSuccess.message: You don't need them to talk. Their body language tells the story.

onFailure.message: Nothing readable in their expression. Professionally blank.
